about.label: About
about.title: Two jobs, one habit.
about.p1: Most days I work in Amsterdam’s public space as a public space enforcer — patrolling, handling disputes and talking with residents and visitors.
about.p2: Alongside that, I build software. The habit that connects both is noticing where work could be simpler, and then building the tool for it.
about.p3: Years in customer-facing roles, from Albert Heijn to Apple, taught me to start with the person who will actually use the thing.
